item.title: Court Administration Chief: "Chief Justice Can Nominate Supreme Court Justice Candidates Based on His Own Judgment" (법원행정처장 “대법원장, 본인 판단 따라 대법관 후보 제청할 수 있다”)
item.description:
Court Administration Chief: "Chief Justice Can Nominate Supreme Court Justice Candidates Based on His Own Judgment" (법원행정처장 “대법원장, 본인 판단 따라 대법관 후보 제청할 수 있다”)

Noh Kyung-pil, head of the Court Administration Office, said on the 19th regarding the ruling party's criticism that Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae made a nomination for a Supreme Court justice without agreement with the presidential office, "Under the Constitution, the Chief Justice has the right to nominate candidates for Supreme Court justice, and the President and the National Assembly should exercise their respective powers of consent and appointment." (노경필 법원행정처장은 19일 조희대 대법원장이 청와대와 합의 없이 대법관 임명 제청을 했다는 여당 지적에 대해 “헌법에 따라 대법원장은 대법관 후보를 제청할 권리가 있고, 대통령과 국회는 각각 동의권과 임명권을 행사하면 된다고 생각한다”고 밝혔다.)

Appearing before the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day, Noh said, "If consultation with the president were required, then by extension consultation with the National Assembly would also be needed, which would infringe on the consent power and thus be inappropriate." (노 처장은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회에 출석해 “대통령과 협의해야 한다면 나아가서 국회와도 협의해야 동의권을 침해하지 않는 셈이 돼서 적절하지 않다”면서 이렇게 말했다.)

In response to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo asking whether "the nomination power would be undermined if the president designates a specific candidate to appoint as Supreme Court justice," Noh stated, "The Chief Justice's nomination right must be guaranteed." Regarding the selection of a successor for former Supreme Court Justice Noh Tae-ak, whose nomination had been pending for over five months, he said, "We have been in continuous consultation (with the presidential office)." (노 처장은 ‘대통령이 특정 후보를 찍어 대법관으로 임명하라 하면 제청권이 무력화되는 게 아니냐’는 국민의힘 주진우 의원 질의에 “대법원장의 제청권은 보장돼야 한다”고 했다. 5개월 넘게 제청이 이뤄지지 않던 노태악 전 대법관의 후임자 인선과 관련해서는 “(청와대와) 계속 협의를 해왔다”고 했다.)

When asked by Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Dong-ah whether "consultations were held but not properly concluded," Noh replied, "We failed to reach an agreement until the end." He added, "I believe the Chief Justice can nominate based on his own judgment," noting, "It is stipulated in the Constitution." (노 처장은 ‘협의했지만 제대로 이뤄지지 않았냐’는 더불어민주당 김동아 의원 질의에는 “끝까지 합의를 이루지 못했다”고 답했다. 이어 “대법원장은 본인 판단에 따라 제청할 수 있다고 생각한다”며 “헌법에 명시돼 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier, Chief Justice Cho had nominated two new Supreme Court justices the previous day, requesting President Lee Jae-myung to appoint Son Bong-ki (60, 22nd class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute), a presiding judge at the Daegu District Court, and Kim Sung-soo (57, 24th class), a presiding judge at the Seoul High Court. Judge Son is the successor to former Supreme Court Justice Noh Tae-ak, who retired in March, while Judge Kim is the successor to Justice Lee Heung-gu, who retires next month. (앞서 조 대법원장은 전날 새 대법관으로 손봉기(60·사법연수원 22기) 대구지법 부장판사와 김성수(57·24기) 서울고법 부장판사를 임명해 달라고 이재명 대통령에게 제청했다. 손 부장판사는 지난 3월 퇴임한 노태악 전 대법관, 김 부장판사는 다음 달 퇴임하는 이흥구 대법관의 후임 후보다.)

However, it was confirmed that Chief Justice Cho did not visit the presidential office to meet President Lee, but instead submitted the nomination in writing. Typically, the Chief Justice would meet the president at the presidential office for final consultations before announcing the nominees for Supreme Court justice. The Supreme Court had conducted multiple rounds of consultations with the presidential office over the successors to the two justices, but it is known that no final agreement was reached on Judge Son, the successor to former Justice Noh Tae-ak, leading to the written nomination. (다만 조 대법원장은 청와대를 방문해 이 대통령을 만나지는 않고, 서면으로 제청한 것으로 확인됐다. 통상 대법원장은 청와대에서 대통령을 만나 최종 협의를 거친 뒤 대법관 제청 대상자를 발표했었다. 대법원은 그동안 두 대법관 후임을 놓고 청와대와 수차례 협의를 진행했으나, 노태악 전 대법관 후임인 손 부장판사에 대해선 최종 합의가 되지 않아 서면 제청을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Former President Moon Meets DP Leader Kim Min-seok: "Internal Wounds Among Party Members Are Deep... Please Make an Effort" (김민석 대표 만난 文 전 대통령 “당원 내상 깊어…노력 기울여달라”)
item.description:
Former President Moon Meets DP Leader Kim Min-seok: "Internal Wounds Among Party Members Are Deep... Please Make an Effort" (김민석 대표 만난 文 전 대통령 “당원 내상 깊어…노력 기울여달라”)

Former President Moon Jae-in told Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, "The intense competition during the national convention process has left deep internal wounds among party members," and asked him to "make a special effort." (문재인 전 대통령이 김민석 더불어민주당 대표에게 “전당대회 과정에서 치열하게 경쟁하다보니 당원끼리 내상이 깊다”며 “각별한 노력을 기울여 달라”고 전했다.)

On this day, Representative Kim visited Pyeongsan Village in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang Province, to meet with former President Moon and his wife. According to senior spokesperson Park Seong-jun, former President Moon said, "The reason the internal wounds within the party are so deep is that language of mockery, contempt, and hatred has run rampant, and such things have fueled the conflict." (이날 김 대표는 경남 양산 평산마을을 찾아 문 전 대통령 내외를 만났다. 문 전 대통령은 “당내 내상이 깊은 이유가 조롱과 멸시, 혐오의 언어가 난무하는데 이런 것들이 갈등을 부추겼다”고 말했다고 박성준 수석대변인이 전했다.)

In response, Representative Kim reportedly answered, "I will play a sufficient role within the party, including launching a campaign to prevent the rampant use of language of mockery, hatred, and contempt." (이에 김 대표는 “조롱과 혐오, 멸시의 언어들이 난무하지 않도록 하는 캠페인을 비롯해 당내에서 충분히 역할을 하겠다”고 답했다고 한다.)

Additionally, according to Senior Spokesperson Park, former President Moon emphasized, "Geoje is my hometown, and there was 100mm of rainfall in one hour—a level not seen in 200 years—and the frequency has been far too high. Yangsan has seen abnormal temperatures exceeding 40 degrees, so we need to pay attention to and prepare for responding to the climate crisis." (또 박 수석대변인에 따르면, 문 전 대통령은 “거제가 고향인데, 200년만에 강수량이 1시간에 100mm 내렸고, 빈도도 너무 잦았다. 양산은 40도가 넘는 이상 기온이 이어져 기후 위기 대응도 관심 갖고 갖춰야한다”고 강조했다고 한다.)

He also mentioned the 'World Youth Day' Catholic event to be held next year and the UN Ocean Conference scheduled for 2028 in Busan. Senior Spokesperson Park stated, "Former President Moon and Representative Kim discussed cooperating and exchanging opinions to ensure both events are successfully held by paying close attention to them." (내년 열리는 ‘천주교 세계청년대회’와 2028년 부산에서 열리는 유엔 해양총회에 대해 언급하기도 했다. 박 수석대변인은 “문 전 대통령과 김 대표가 관심을 기울여서 두 행사가 성공리에 치러지도록 협조하고 의견을 교류하자고 말씀을 나눴다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the appointment of Kim Min-seok's leadership team was also announced at this meeting. Two-term lawmaker Moon Jin-seok was appointed as the party's Senior Deputy Secretary-General, and first-term lawmaker Ahn Tae-joon as Organizational Deputy Secretary-General. Additionally, lawmaker Kang Deuk-gu was appointed as the head of the Democratic Research Institute Innovation Task Force, which will oversee the reorganization of the institute. (한편, 이 자리에서 김민석 지도부의 인선 발표도 이뤄졌다. 당 수석사무부총장에 재선 문진석 의원, 조직부총장에 초선 안태준 의원이 임명됐다. 또 민주연구원 개편을 맡을 민주연구원 혁신 TF 단장에 강득구 의원이 임명됐다.)

Before visiting Pyeongsan, the party leadership, including Representative Kim, visited the grave of the late former President Roh Moo-hyun in Bongha Village, Jinyeong-eup, Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province. After completing the memorial visit, Representative Kim wrote in the guestbook: "The path of civic sovereignty paved through personal sacrifice—I will open it wide as a model for the world." (평산 방문에 앞서 김 대표를 비롯한 당 지도부는 경남 김해시 진영읍 봉하마을을 찾아 고 노무현 전 대통령 묘역을 참배했다. 김 대표는 참배를 마치고 방명록에 “몸소 여신 시민 주권의 길 세계의 모범으로 활짝 열겠습니다”라고 적었다.)

item.title: National Assembly Science Committee Session Breaks Down... Clash Over Lee Jin-sook's 'May 18 Discussion Forum' (국회 과방위 파행…이진숙 ‘5·18 토론회’ 논란으로 충돌)
item.description:
National Assembly Science Committee Session Breaks Down... Clash Over Lee Jin-sook's 'May 18 Discussion Forum' (국회 과방위 파행…이진숙 ‘5·18 토론회’ 논란으로 충돌)

Rival parties clashed on the 19th at the National Assembly's Science, ICT, Broadcasting, and Communications Committee plenary session over a forum on the May 18 Democratization Movement hosted by People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jin-sook. The confrontation led to the meeting being suspended twice and ultimately adjourned, marking a breakdown in proceedings. (여야는 19일 국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회 전체회의에서 국민의힘 이진숙 의원 주최 5·18 민주화운동 관련 국회 토론회를 두고 공방을 벌였다. 여야 대치로 회의가 두 차례 정회했고, 결국 산회하는 등 파행이 빚어졌다.)

The Democratic Party claimed that Lee had insulted the victims and bereaved families of the May 18 Democratization Movement and demanded her resignation from the committee and from her parliamentary seat. Ahead of the committee meeting, Democratic Party lawmakers held a press conference and stated, "Lee has forced through an event that distorts history, tramples on national consensus, and belittles the May 18 movement, going against the spirit of the times." (민주당은 이 의원이 5·18 민주화운동 희생자와 유가족을 모욕했다고 주장하며 이 의원의 과방위원 사임 및 국회의원직 사퇴를 요구했다. 민주당 의원들은 과방위 회의에 앞서 기자회견을 열어 “이 의원은 역사를 왜곡하고 국민적 합의를 짓밟으며 시대정신을 거스르는 5·18 왜곡·폄훼 행사를 강행했다”고 했다.)

During the meeting, Democratic Party lawmakers also demanded Lee's departure through points of order. Han Joon-ho, the Democratic Party's committee secretary, said during the session, "The May 18 Special Act prohibits the dissemination of false information" and asked, "Does attaching the label of an academic forum grant immunity?" (민주당 의원들은 회의에서도 의사진행 발언을 통해 이 의원의 퇴장을 요구했다. 과방위 여당 간사인 한준호 의원은 회의에서 “5·18민주화특별법은 허위사실 유포를 금지하고 있다”며 “학술 포럼이라는 이름을 붙였다고 해 면죄부가 되겠나”라고 했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Jung-heon addressed Lee Jin-sook directly, saying, "Under the guise of reexamining the May 18 Democratization Movement, you have dragged in claims that 'May 18 was the main culprit behind the corruption and decay of the 1987 system'" and added, "You have driven another nail into the hearts of the citizens of Gwangju, the bereaved families, and the victims of May 18." Lawmaker Hwang Jung-ah also said, "Those who disparage the democratization movement as a riot and praise Chun Doo-hwan, the one responsible for the massacre, have entered the National Assembly using Lee Jin-sook as a stepping stone" and added, "This is not a matter of ruling versus opposition parties, but a difference between common sense and nonsense, between normal and abnormal." (민주당 이정헌 의원은 이진숙 의원을 향해 “5·18 민주화운동을 재조명한다는 명목으로 ‘5·18이 1987년 체제 오염과 타락의 주범’이라는 주장까지 끌어들였다”며 “광주시민과 5·18 유가족, 희생자들 가슴에 다시 한번 대못을 박았다”고 했다. 황정아 의원도 “민주화운동을 소요사태라고 폄훼하고 학살의 책임자인 전두환을 칭송하는 자들이 이진숙 의원을 발판으로 국회에 들어왔다”며 “여야의 문제가 아니라 상식과 비상식, 정상과 비정상의 차이”라고 했다.)

Lee expressed regret over the Democratic Party's claims, saying, "The democratization movement should not become a sacred cow." She stated, "It is because of the May 18 Democratization Movement that we enjoy this democracy" and "The foremost value is freedom of expression." (이 의원은 민주당의 주장에 유감을 표하며 “민주화운동이 성역이 돼서는 안 된다”고 했다. 그는 “5·18 민주화운동을 했기 때문에 우리가 이 민주주의를 누리고 있는 것”이라며 “제일 첫 번째 가치는 표현의 자유”라고 했다.)

She said, "I began my remarks by expressing condolences for the victims and bereaved families, especially those who passed away. I have no authority to dictate or control the content of the academic discussion." (그는 “저는 피해자와 유족들에 대해, 특히 사망하신 분들에 대해 명복을 빈다고 인사말을 시작했다. 학술 토론회 내용에 대해 제가 이래라저래라 통제할 권한은 없다”고 했다.)

Choi Hyung-du, the People Power Party's committee secretary, also said, "The claim that remarks raised at an academic event reflect Lee's personal views and positions is inconsistent and factually incorrect." (과방위 국민의힘 간사인 최형두 의원도 “학술행사에서 제기된 발언이 이 의원의 생각이고 입장이라는 것은 앞뒤가 맞지 않고 사실관계도 다르다”고 했다.)

When independent lawmaker Choi Hyeok-jin asked, "How can we sit in the same room with a serious criminal and deliberate on the committee's budget settlement?" Lee Jin-sook shouted back, "Why am I a serious criminal?" (무소속 최혁진 의원이 “중대범죄자와 이 자리에 같이 앉아서 과방위 결산 심의를 할 수 있겠느냐”고 하자 이진숙 의원이 “내가 왜 중대범죄자냐”고 외치기도 했다.)

Committee Chairman Song Ki-heon said, "This committee has responsibility over false and manipulated information" and added, "As chairman, for this committee to proceed normally, I believe Lee should offer an apology on this matter and move on." (송기헌 과방위원장은 “(과방위는) 허위조작정보에 대해 책임을 갖는 상임위원회”라면서 “위원장으로서 과방위가 정상 진행되기 위해서는 이 부분에 대해 이 의원이 사과 말씀을 하시고 넘어가야 한다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

However, Lee pushed back, saying, "Democratic Party lawmakers are unleashing remarks at the level of collective violence." (하지만 이 의원은 “민주당 의원들이 집단 폭력 수준의 발언을 쏟아내고 있다”며 반발했다.)

The meeting suffered disruptions, being suspended twice in the morning alone. Ahead of the afternoon session, the ruling and opposition party secretaries attempted to coordinate positions but failed to reach an agreement, and Chairman Song declared the meeting adjourned, saying it could not proceed normally. (이날 회의는 오전 중에만 두 차례 정회하는 등 파행을 겪었다. 오후 회의를 앞두고 여야 간사가 의견을 조율했지만 합의에 이르지 못했고, 송 위원장은 회의가 정상적으로 진행될 수 없다며 산회를 선포했다.)

item.title: Court Administration Chief: "Blue House Didn't Give Opportunity to Meet President Lee... Written Recommendation Coordinated with Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs" (법원행정처장 “靑, 李대통령 만날 기회 안줘…서면제청, 민정수석과 협의”)
item.description:
Court Administration Chief: "Blue House Didn't Give Opportunity to Meet President Lee... Written Recommendation Coordinated with Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs" (법원행정처장 “靑, 李대통령 만날 기회 안줘…서면제청, 민정수석과 협의”)

Court Administration Chief Noh Kyung-pil said on the 19th, in response to the ruling party's criticism that Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae had made a written recommendation for Supreme Court justice appointments without agreement from the Blue House, that "there was no opportunity for a meeting" and that "we requested it, but it didn't happen." (노경필 법원행정처장은 19일 조희대 대법원장이 청와대와 합의 없이 대법관 임명을 서면으로 제청했다는 여당 지적에 대해 “만남의 기회가 없었다”며 “(청와대에) 요구했는데 안 됐다”고 밝혔다.)

Chief Noh made these remarks while attending a plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, answering a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min, who asked, "Whose idea was it to make the written recommendation?" (노 처장은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에 출석해 ‘서면 제청하자는 아이디어는 누가 낸 건가’라는 더불어민주당 김용민 의원 질의에 이렇게 답했다.)

Chief Noh said, "The written recommendation came up during discussions with the Blue House's senior secretary for civil affairs," adding, "I don't remember exactly who proposed it first." He continued, "Originally, the procedure is a written recommendation," and "The chief justice and the president meet to discuss, and then the next step is to send it in writing to the Ministry of Personnel Management." (노 처장은 “(서면 제청은) 청와대 민정수석 측과 협의하는 과정에서 나온 얘기”라며 “누가 먼저 제안했는지는 정확하게 기억나지 않는다”고 했다. 이어 “원래 (절차가) 서면 제청”이라며 “(제청 전 대법원장과 대통령이) 만나서 말씀을 나누고 그다음 절차는 서면으로 인사혁신처에 보내는 것”이라고 했다.)

When Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo, also of the Democratic Party, asked, "Who proposed the written recommendation?" he responded, "The two of them (the president and the chief justice) usually meet, reach an agreement, and then send it in writing, but since they weren't given the opportunity to meet and reach an agreement, in the end, there was no choice but to use the last remaining method." He added, "We coordinated with the senior secretary for civil affairs and agreed on the method of making a written recommendation." (이어 민주당 소속 서영교 법사위원장이 ‘서면 제청을 누가 제안했냐’고 묻자 “두 분(대통령과 대법원장)이 만나서 합의한 이후 서면으로 보내는데, 두 분이 만나서 합의할 기회를 주지 않았기 때문에 결국 마지막 남은 방법밖에 없었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “민정수석과 협의해서 서면 제청하는 방법을 합의했다”고 했다.)

Earlier, Chief Justice Cho had recommended to President Lee Jae-myung the appointment of new Supreme Court justices: Son Bong-ki (60, Judicial Research and Training Institute class 22), a presiding judge at the Daegu District Court, and Kim Sung-soo (57, class 24), a presiding judge at the Seoul High Court. Judge Son is the candidate to succeed former Justice Noh Tae-ak, who retired in March, while Judge Kim is the candidate to succeed Justice Lee Heung-gu, who is retiring next month. (앞서 조 대법원장은 전날 새 대법관으로 손봉기(60·사법연수원 22기) 대구지법 부장판사와 김성수(57·24기) 서울고법 부장판사를 임명해 달라고 이재명 대통령에게 제청했다. 손 부장판사는 지난 3월 퇴임한 노태악 전 대법관, 김 부장판사는 다음 달 퇴임하는 이흥구 대법관의 후임 후보다.)

However, it was confirmed that Chief Justice Cho did not visit the Blue House to meet President Lee and instead made the recommendation in writing. Typically, the chief justice would meet the president at the Blue House for final consultations before announcing the candidates for Supreme Court justice appointments. The Supreme Court had held several rounds of consultations with the Blue House over the successors for the two justices, but it is known that no final agreement was reached regarding Judge Son, the successor to former Justice Noh, leading to the written recommendation. (다만 조 대법원장은 청와대를 방문해 이 대통령을 만나지는 않고, 서면으로 제청한 것으로 확인됐다. 통상 대법원장은 청와대에서 대통령을 만나 최종 협의를 거친 뒤 대법관 제청 대상자를 발표했었다. 대법원은 그동안 두 대법관 후임을 놓고 청와대와 수차례 협의를 진행했으나, 노태악 전 대법관 후임인 손 부장판사에 대해선 최종 합의가 되지 않아 서면 제청을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Korea-China talks discuss Korean Peninsula issues... China's Wang Yi says "will play a constructive role" (한중 회담서 한반도 문제 논의... 中왕이 “건설적 역할하겠다”)
item.description:
Korea-China talks discuss Korean Peninsula issues... China's Wang Yi says "will play a constructive role" (한중 회담서 한반도 문제 논의... 中왕이 “건설적 역할하겠다”)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul held a meeting with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi during his visit to South Korea on the 19th, discussing bilateral issues and the situation on the Korean Peninsula, including North Korea-related matters. Wang's standalone visit to South Korea for a foreign ministers' meeting marks the first in five years since September 2021. (조현 외교부 장관이 19일 방한한 왕이 중국 외교부장(장관)과 회담을 갖고 양국 현안과 북한 문제를 비롯한 한반도 정세에 대해 논의했다. 왕 부장이 외교장관 회담을 위해 단독 방한한 것은 2021년 9월 이후 5년 만이다.)

In his opening remarks at the meeting, Minister Cho said, "I hope the achievements in restoring Korea-China relations can contribute to peace and stability in the region, including the Korean Peninsula," adding, "As President Lee Jae-myung recently presented a blueprint for peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula in his Liberation Day address, the South Korean government will continue its efforts toward denuclearization and peace on the Korean Peninsula." (조 장관은 회담 모두발언에서 “한중 관계 복원의 성과가 한반도를 포함한 역내에 평화와 안정에 기여할 수 있도록 노력했으면 좋겠다”며 “이재명 대통령께서 최근 광복절 경축사를 통해 한반도 평화 공존의 청사진을 제시하신 만큼 한국 정부는 한반도 비핵화와 평화 실현을 위해 노력해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

He further stated, "I look forward to cooperating with China based on the shared interests of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, and I anticipate having a candid and in-depth conversation with Minister Wang today." (이어 “한반도의 평화 안정이라는 한중 공동의 이익에 기반해 중국과 함께 협력해 나가기를 기대하며 오늘 왕 부장과 솔직하고 깊이 있는 대화를 나누기를 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

In response, Minister Wang said, "As the most important neighboring country of the Korean Peninsula, China will continue to play a constructive role for the peace, development, and stability of the peninsula," adding, "We will make the efforts we ought to make." (이에 왕 부장은 “한반도의 제일 중요한 이웃 나라로서 중국 측은 한반도의 평화와 발전, 평화와 안정을 위해 계속해서 건설적인 역할을 하겠다”며 “우리는 응당히 해야 할 노력을 하겠다”고 했다.)

He continued, "We also hope that South Korea and North Korea can gradually move toward opportunities for peace and coexistence, and we sincerely wish for the sustained stability and development of the Korean Peninsula." (이어 “우리는 또한 한국과 북한 두 나라가 점차적으로 평화 또한 공존의 기회를 따라나갈 수 있는 것을 바라고 또한 한반도의 지속적인 안정과 발전을 이루기를 진심으로 축원한다”고 했다.)

This Korea-China foreign ministers' meeting took place after President Lee proposed "discussions among the parties concerned to end the war" in his Liberation Day address on the 15th. The government plans to deploy diplomatic efforts so that Korean Peninsula issues can be discussed positively on the occasion of the upcoming U.S.-China summit in September. (이번 한중 외교장관 회담은 이 대통령이 지난 15일 광복절 경축사에서 ‘전쟁 종식을 위한 당사자들 논의’를 제안한 상태에서 진행됐다. 정부는 오는 9월 미·중 정상회담 등을 계기로 한반도 문제가 긍정적으로 논의될 수 있도록 외교력을 투입한다는 방침이다.)

The meeting was scheduled for 6 p.m. that day, and Minister Wang arrived at the Foreign Ministry building around 6:15 p.m. After the meeting, the two ministers moved to a dinner venue to continue their dialogue. On the 20th, Minister Wang is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on President Lee at the presidential office, and hold a meeting and luncheon with National Security Office Director Shin Wonsik. (이날 회담은 오후 6시로 예정됐는데 왕 부장은 오후 6시15분쯤 외교부 청사에 도착했다. 양 장관은 회담 후 자리를 옮겨 만찬을 하며 대화를 이어갔다. 왕 부장은 20일에는 청와대에서 이 대통령을 예방하고, 위성락 국가안보실장과 회담·오찬을 할 계획이다.)

item.title: Wang Yi on Possible Mediation of US-North Korea Summit: "US Must Change Its Hostile Policy Toward North Korea" (왕이 미북 회담 중재 가능성에 “미 대북 적대 정책 바꿔야”)
item.description:
Wang Yi on Possible Mediation of US-North Korea Summit: "US Must Change Its Hostile Policy Toward North Korea" (왕이 미북 회담 중재 가능성에 “미 대북 적대 정책 바꿔야”)

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on the 19th regarding the possibility of mediating a US-North Korea summit, "This is a matter to be decided between North Korea and the United States, and in particular, the US must change its long-standing hostile policy toward North Korea." The Wall Street Journal reported on the 18th (local time) that US President Donald Trump is reviewing plans to push for a US-North Korea summit on the occasion of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting scheduled for November in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China. (왕이 중국 외교부장이 19일 미·북 정상회담 중재 가능성에 대해 “북한과 미국 사이에 결정할 일이며, 특히 미국은 오랫동안 유지해 온 대북 적대 정책을 바꿔야 한다”고 했다. 미국 월스트리트저널은 18일(현지 시각) 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령이 11월 중국 광둥성 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 등을 계기로 미·북 정상회담을 추진하는 방안을 검토하고 있다고 보도했다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul held a meeting with Minister Wang at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Doryeom-dong, Seoul, on the same day to discuss bilateral issues and North Korea matters. Minister Wang visited South Korea as part of a delegation during the Gyeongju APEC leaders' meeting in October last year, but this is his first standalone visit to South Korea for a foreign ministers' meeting since September 2021, marking five years. (조현 외교부 장관이 이날 서울 도렴동 외교부에서 왕 부장과 회담을 갖고 양국 현안과 북한 문제 등을 논의했다. 왕 부장은 지난해 10월 경주 APEC 정상회의 때 수행단으로 방한했지만, 외교장관 회담을 위해 단독 방한한 것은 2021년 9월 이후 5년 만이다.)

In his opening remarks, Minister Cho said, "We expect to cooperate with China based on the common interest of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." President Lee Jae-myung proposed "discussions among the parties concerned to end the war" in his Liberation Day address on the 15th, and the government plans to use occasions such as the US-China summit scheduled for September in the United States to draw North Korea to the dialogue table. (조 장관은 모두발언에서 “한반도의 평화·안정이라는 공동의 이익에 기반해 중국과 협력해 나가기를 기대한다”고 말했다. 이재명 대통령은 지난 15일 광복절 경축사에서 ‘전쟁 종식을 위한 당사자들 논의’를 제안했고 정부는 9월 미국에서 열리는 미·중 정상회담 등을 계기로 북한을 대화 테이블로 유도하겠다는 구상이다.)

Minister Wang said, "China will continue to play a constructive role for peace, development, and stability on the Korean Peninsula." However, regarding mediation of a US-North Korea summit, he maintained his existing stance, including the need for "changes in the US hostile policy toward North Korea." Minister Wang visited Pyongyang last April, held talks with North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui, and paid a courtesy call on Chairman Kim Jong-un. (왕 부장은 “중국은 한반도의 평화와 발전, 안정을 위해 계속해서 건설적인 역할을 하겠다”고 했다. 하지만 미·북 정상회담 중재에 대해선 “미국의 대북 적대 정책 변화” 등 기존 입장을 고수한 것이다. 왕 부장은 지난 4월 평양을 방문해 최선희 북한 외무상과 회담을 갖고 김정은 국무위원장을 예방했다.)

The meeting also appears to have addressed the issue of Chinese structures installed in the West Sea Provisional Measures Zone (PMZ). After President Lee's state visit to China in January, the Chinese side moved one large steel structure out of the PMZ, but the remaining two remain in the PMZ, and related consultations between South Korea and China are ongoing. At a meeting with reporters, Minister Wang emphasized that cooperation with China, the world's largest market, benefits South Korea, saying, "As the saying goes, 'A waterside pavilion gets the moonlight first,' strengthening Korea-China cooperation is also favorable to South Korea's development." (이날 회담에선 서해 잠정조치수역(PMZ) 내 중국 구조물 설치 문제도 논의된 것으로 보인다. 중국 측은 지난 1월 이 대통령 국빈 방중 이후 대형 철제 구조물 1기를 PMZ 밖으로 이동시켰지만 나머지 2기는 PMZ에 있어 한중 간 관련 협의가 진행 중이다. 왕 부장은 취재진과 만난 자리에서 세계 최대 시장인 중국과의 협력이 한국에 유리하다고 강조하며 “근수루대 선득월(近水楼台 先得月·물가에 있는 누각이 달빛을 먼저 받는다)이라는 말처럼 한중 협력 강화는 한국의 발전에도 유리하다”고 했다.)

On the 20th, Minister Wang will pay a courtesy call on President Lee at the presidential office (Yongsan) and also meet with National Security Office Director Shin Won-sik. There is also a possibility he will request President Lee's attendance at the APEC leaders' meeting scheduled for November in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China. (왕 부장은 20일 청와대에서 이 대통령을 예방하고 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장도 만난다. 오는 11월 중국 광둥성 선전에서 열리는 APEC 정상회의에 이 대통령 참석을 요청할 가능성도 있다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Lawmaker Kim Jun-hwan Calls Defector-Turned-Opposition Lawmaker "Someone Who Chanted Long Live Kim Il-sung" (與김준환, 탈북민 출신 野의원에 “김일성 만세하던 사람”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Lawmaker Kim Jun-hwan Calls Defector-Turned-Opposition Lawmaker "Someone Who Chanted Long Live Kim Il-sung" (與김준환, 탈북민 출신 野의원에 “김일성 만세하던 사람”)

At the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee meeting held on the 19th, Kim Jun-hwan, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, reportedly referred to Park Choong-kwon, a lawmaker from the People Power Party who is a North Korean defector, as "someone who chanted long live Kim Il-sung." After controversy erupted, Kim apologized to Park, saying, "I caused an indelible wound to a fellow lawmaker." (19일 열린 국회 외통위에서 김준환 더불어민주당 의원이 탈북민 출신 박충권 국민의힘 의원을 향해 “김일성 만세를 부르던 사람”이라고 말한 것으로 알려졌다. 김 의원은 논란이 일자 “동료 의원에게 씻을 수 없는 아픔을 줬다”고 박 의원에게 사과했다.)

Park revealed the situation surrounding Kim's remarks through a personal statement after the committee's plenary session resumed that afternoon. As Park was leaving the meeting room after finishing his morning questioning, he encountered Kim, who grabbed his hand and said, "My father is a national merit holder, and I worked at the National Intelligence Service for 25 years." Kim, a former NIS official, served as deputy director of the agency during the Moon Jae-in administration. When Park responded, "Since you're a merit holder, you should be even more careful," Kim reportedly let go of his hand and said, "You people are the ones who chanted 'long live Kim Il-sung.' Be careful." <<> While recounting this situation, Park said, "When I heard Kim's words, I couldn't believe my ears. I was truly shocked." He added, "The more than 34,000 North Korean defectors, including myself, are people who resolutely rejected the dictatorship of the Kim Il-sung family and chose the free democratic Republic of Korea. Calling someone like that 'a person who chanted long live Kim Il-sung' denies the lives and efforts of all North Korean defectors." Park graduated from Pyongyang's National Defense University and defected from North Korea in 2009. <<> In response, Kim said, "Perhaps because the suffering Park endured in North Korea has become a trauma, he tends to disparage any effort by the Democratic Party toward unification, and in the end, I said something that should never have been uttered." He added, "I sincerely apologize for the words I spat out that became a dagger in the heart." <<> The clash between the two lawmakers originated from the morning questioning. Park criticized Unification Minister Chung Dong-young for recently proposing, in a briefing to the presidential office, to refer to North Korea by its official name, the "Democratic People's Republic of Korea," and to replace terms like "main enemy" with "threat." Park demanded, "Are you a spokesperson representing North Korea's position? Resign immediately." <<> As the argument continued, Kim urged Park to exercise restraint and asked, "Since when have you been talking about the main enemy?" Park responded, "I came to South Korea because I opposed the main enemy concept. If I can't say a word about this, am I even a lawmaker? All of Minister Chung's actions are unconstitutional and constitute a traitorous declaration of abandoning territory." (박 의원은 이날 오후 외통위 전체회의가 속개된 후 신상 발언을 통해 김 의원 발언이 나온 상황을 전했다. 박 의원이 오전 질의를 마치고 회의장을 퇴장하던 중 만난 김 의원이 손을 잡으며 “우리 아버지가 국가유공자고, 나는 국가정보원에서 25년간 일한 사람”이라고 했다. 국정원 출신인 김 의원은 문재인 정부 당시 국정원 차장을 지냈다. 박 의원이 “유공자시니 더 확실하게 하셔야 한다”고 하자, 김 의원이 손을 놓고 “당신들은 ‘김일성 만세’를 부르던 사람들이야. 조심해”라고 했다고 한다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "Lee must leave party to become president for all" (이석연 “李, 탈당해야 모두의 대통령 가능”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "Lee must leave party to become president for all" (이석연 “李, 탈당해야 모두의 대통령 가능”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chairman of the Presidential Committee for National Integration, publicly suggested that President Lee Jae-myung leave the Democratic Party of Korea, saying, "If you want to become the president for all, I hope you now step outside the political fence of being the president of a single party." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장이 이재명 대통령에게 “모두의 대통령이 되고자 한다면 이제는 한 정당의 대통령이라는 정치적 울타리에서 벗어나셨으면 한다”며 더불어민주당 탈당을 공개 건의했다.)

Appearing on MBC's "100-minute Debate" on the night of the 18th, Chairman Lee said, "Leave the Democratic Party to its new leadership, and return as the president of the people, not the president of the Democratic Party." He added, "The ruling party is competing over who is closest to the president, and the opposition is taking an extreme stance of confrontation against the president and the government. I worry that politics is now dividing sides around the president." Lee, who served as head of the Ministry of Government Legislation under the Lee Myung-bak administration, is a conservative figure who was carefully recruited by President Lee during the last presidential election and then appointed as committee chairman. However, since taking office, he has continued to offer blunt criticism of the Democratic Party's prosecution and judicial reforms. <<> That day, Chairman Lee also said, "As chairman of the National Integration Committee, I offer words to the president that may be somewhat uncomfortable. If this is discourteous, I will take responsibility for it." He continued, "The president has said whenever he had the chance that he would become the 'president for all,' but he must feel the heaviest responsibility for the current chaos in state affairs and the severe division of public opinion." In a phone call with this newspaper on the 19th, he reiterated his call for the president to leave the Democratic Party, saying, "Receiving support from Democratic Party members and gaining the trust of the people are separate matters. Past presidents have increasingly fallen into lame-duck status and were effectively driven out of their parties before leaving them." (이 위원장은 18일 밤 MBC ‘100분 토론’에 출연해 “민주당은 새 지도부에 맡기고, 대통령은 민주당의 대통령이 아닌 국민의 대통령으로 돌아오라”며 이같이 말했다. 그는 “여당은 대통령과 누가 가깝냐 경쟁하고 야당은 대통령과 정부를 향해 극단적인 반대 입장에서 각을 세우고 있다”며 “지금 대통령을 중심으로 정치가 편을 가르는 것이 아닌지 염려도 든다”고 했다. 이명박 정부 법제처장을 지낸 이 위원장은 보수 성향 인사인데 지난 대선 때 이 대통령이 공들여 영입한 뒤 통합위원장에 발탁했다. 하지만 이 위원장은 취임 후 민주당의 검찰·사법 개혁 등에 쓴소리를 이어왔다.)

Regarding the impeachment calls against Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae coming from the ruling party, Chairman Lee said, "The crime of displeasing someone cannot be grounds for impeachment." He stated, "Impeaching the chief justice would trigger severe division and conflict in public opinion. Actual impeachment is difficult to realize, and if they try to push it, the government and ruling party could face backlash." He added, "Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Min-seok is talking about impeachment while addressing Chief Justice Cho rudely by his name alone. A person who has served as prime minister of a country and just became the leader of an absolute majority party should not incite the public with such coarse language." (이 위원장은 이날도 “국민통합위원장으로서 대통령께 조금은 불편할 수 있는 말씀을 드린다. 결례가 된다면 그 책임도 제가 지겠다”며 “대통령은 ‘모두의 대통령’이 되겠다고 기회 있을 때마다 말했지만, 지금의 국정 난맥과 극심한 국론 분열 현상에 가장 무거운 책임을 느껴야 한다”고 했다. 19일 본지 통화에서도 “민주당 당원의 지지를 받는 것과 국민 신뢰를 얻는 것은 별개다. 역대 대통령들이 갈수록 레임덕 현상에 빠지면서 당에서 쫓겨나다시피 탈당을 당했다”며 대통령의 민주당 탈당을 재차 주장했다.)

However, Chairman Lee also noted, "Chief Justice Cho himself has aspects of continually stoking conflict. If he disagreed with the presidential office over the selection of new Supreme Court justices, he should have made efforts to coordinate and find common ground on his own." (이 위원장은 여당에서 나오는 조희대 대법원장 탄핵 요구에 대해선 “괘씸죄가 탄핵 사유가 될 수는 없다”고 했다. 그는 “대법원장 탄핵은 극심한 국론 분열과 갈등을 야기한다”며 “실제 탄핵이 현실화되기도 어렵고, 탄핵하려 한다면 오히려 정부·여당이 역풍을 맞을 수 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “민주당 김민석 대표가 반말로 ‘조희대씨’라고 하면서 탄핵을 이야기하는데, 한 나라의 총리까지 지내고 엊그제 절대다수당의 대표가 된 사람이 그런 거친 말로 국민을 선동해서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Seniors, Not Demanding Leader's Resignation, Not Running Would Help in General Election" (장동혁 “중진들, 대표 사퇴 요구 아닌 불출마가 총선에 도움”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Seniors, Not Demanding Leader's Resignation, Not Running Would Help in General Election" (장동혁 “중진들, 대표 사퇴 요구 아닌 불출마가 총선에 도움”)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on the 19th, targeting senior lawmakers, that not running in the 2028 general election would be helpful to the party. This came after it was reported that senior party lawmakers recently expressed concerns about Jang's management of the party. Kim Min-soo, a supreme council member close to Jang, also argued that day for Jang to serve another term. Jang's term runs until August next year. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 19일 중진 의원들을 겨냥해 2028년 총선에 불출마하는 것이 당에 도움이 된다는 취지로 말했다. 최근 당 중진 의원들이 장 대표의 당 운영을 우려한 것으로 알려지자 이같이 말한 것이다. 장 대표와 가까운 김민수 최고위원은 이날 장 대표 연임을 주장하기도 했다. 장 대표 임기는 내년 8월까지다.)

Appearing on the Pen & Mike YouTube channel that morning, Jang said, "If senior lawmakers gather and voice such (critical) opinions, I want to ask whether that helps the party." Third-term PPP lawmakers held a closed-door dinner meeting on the 17th, where opinions emerged that "with Jang's hard-line supporter-centered approach, winning the 2028 general election is difficult." Jang said, "People's lives are collapsing, and what they say when they gather is, 'Under the 1.5-term Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, we'll lose the general election. We need to replace the leader'?" Jang became a lawmaker through the June 1 by-election in 2022. (장 대표는 이날 오전 펜앤마이크 유튜브에 출연해 “중진 의원들이 모여서 그런(자신에 비판적인) 목소리를 낸다면 그게 당에 도움이 되는지 묻고 싶다”고 말했다. 국민의힘 3선 의원들은 지난 17일 비공개 만찬 회동을 했고, 이 자리에서 “강성 지지층 중심의 장 대표 노선으로는 2028년 총선 승리가 어렵다”는 의견이 나왔다. 장 대표는 “국민의 삶은 무너지고 있는데 모여서 한다는 얘기가 ‘1.5선 장동혁 대표 체제로는 총선 진다. 대표 바꿔야 된다’는 것이냐”라고 했다. 장 대표는 지난 2022년 6·1 국회의원 보궐선거를 통해 국회의원이 됐다.)

He then said, "How can you win with the mindset of killing off the leader to fight the next general election?" adding, "If the seniors make sacrifices, declare they won't run in the next (general election), and pave the way for young talent to join the PPP, we can get far better results in the next general election." In other words, rather than his own resignation, a large-scale overhaul of incumbent lawmakers would help win the general election. (이어 그는 “대표 한 명 죽여서 다음 총선을 치르겠다는 생각으로 어떻게 승리하겠나”라며 “중진들이 희생하고 다음번에 (총선) 불출마 선언하고, 젊은 인재들이 국민의힘에 들어올 수 있게 길을 터주면 다음 총선에서 훨씬 더 좋은 결과를 얻을 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 자신의 사퇴보다는 현역 의원들의 대규모 물갈이가 총선 승리에 도움이 된다는 것이다.)

Regarding some senior lawmakers in the party having a golf meeting with President Lee Jae-myung, Jang said, "We're in a situation where it's not enough to fight the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party, yet you play golf with a president who dreams of a second term and constitutional amendment, and you insist on amending the constitution, and every day you talk only about how Jang Dong-hyuk will lose the general election and should resign—how will you win the general election with that?" (장 대표는 당내 일부 중진 의원이 이재명 대통령과 골프 회동을 한 데 대해 “이재명 정부, 민주당과 맞서 싸워도 시원찮을 판에 연임 개헌을 꿈꾸는 대통령과 골프를 치고 개헌을 해야 한다고 주장하는 모습들, 매일 장동혁으로는 총선 진다며 사퇴 얘기만 하는 모습들로 총선을 이기겠느냐”고도 했다.)

Cho Kwang-han, a supreme council member appointed by Jang, wrote on Facebook that day about the third-term lawmakers' meeting: "Like a broken record, they repeated pathetic, frustrating, utterly useless words." Pro-leadership supreme council member Kim Min-soo also said of Jang, "No party leader has shown such reform will before," and "I believe Jang should serve another term." (장 대표가 임명한 조광한 최고위원은 이날 페이스북에 3선 회동을 두고 “고장 난 레코드판처럼 한심하고 답답한 아무 도움이 안 되는 말을 반복 연출했다”고 했다. 당권파인 김민수 최고위원도 장 대표에 대해 “이렇게 개혁 의지를 보였던 당 대표는 없었다”며 “장 대표가 연임을 해야 맞다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

The PPP plans to elect district party branch chairs in August. In this regard, Jang's position is that all district branch chairs, including incumbent lawmakers, should resign and be re-elected through party member voting. Until now, when an incumbent lawmaker served as district branch chair, their term was extended at the district level. A party official said, "This requires a decision by the supreme council, so discussions will take place at the supreme council meeting on the 20th," adding, "I understand there are differences of opinion within the leadership over the method of selecting district branch chairs." (국민의힘은 8월 지역별 당협위원장을 선출할 예정이다. 이와 관련해 장 대표는 현역 의원을 포함해 모든 당협위원장이 사퇴한 후 당원 투표로 재선출하자는 입장이다. 지금까지는 현역 의원이 당협위원장인 경우 당협 차원에서 임기를 재연장해 왔다. 이에 대해 당 관계자는 “최고위 의결이 필요한 부분이라 20일 최고위원 회의에서 관련해서 논의가 진행될 예정”이라며 “당협위원장 선출 방식에 대해 지도부 내에서도 이견이 있는 것으로 안다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the PPP's ethics committee is expected to decide on the severity of disciplinary action on the 20th for lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-su, and Jin Jong-oh, who were referred for discipline over various controversial remarks. On the same day, a general meeting of lawmakers is planned to confirm third-term lawmaker Lim I-ja, who is favorable to Jang, as the new policy committee chairman. Lim reportedly expressed support for Jang at the third-term lawmakers' meeting. One lawmaker with weak factional ties said, "Jang seems to be trying to establish leadership through replacing district branch chairs and ethics committee discipline, but if he fails to gain consensus within the party, it could backfire." (이런 가운데 국민의힘 윤리위원회는 20일 각종 발언 논란으로 징계에 회부된 조경태·권영진·서범수·진종오 의원 등에 대한 징계 수위를 결정할 것으로 알려졌다. 또 같은 날 의원총회를 열고 장 대표에게 우호적인 3선의 임이자 의원을 정책위의장으로 추인할 방침이다. 임 의원은 지난 3선 의원 회동에서 장 대표를 지지하는 발언을 한 것으로 알려졌다. 계파색이 옅은 한 의원은 “장 대표가 당협위원장 교체와 윤리위 징계로 리더십을 세우려는 분위기지만 당내 공감을 얻지 못할 경우 역효과가 날 수도 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea's Kim Yo Jong: "I Know Nothing of Any Communication Between North Korea and US Leaders" (北김여정 “북미 지도자 간 소통, 전혀 알지 못하는 일”)
item.description:
North Korea's Kim Yo Jong: "I Know Nothing of Any Communication Between North Korea and US Leaders" (北김여정 “북미 지도자 간 소통, 전혀 알지 못하는 일”)

<<>> Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, said on the 19th regarding President Donald Trump's claim of communication with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un that "communication between the leaders of North Korea and the US is something I know nothing about." ()

In a statement titled "Position Statement on Major International Issues" released through the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) that day, Kim made these remarks. She added, "It is perhaps the only matter related to our top leadership's foreign policy that I am unaware of." This implies that even she, the sister of Chairman Kim Jong Un, was not informed of such communication. (김여정 북한 노동당 총무부장이 19일 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 소통했다고 주장한 것에 대해 “북미 지도자 간 소통은 전혀 알지 못하는 일”이라고 했다.)

However, Kim noted, "I have already stated on several occasions that our head of state (Kim Jong Un) has positive personal memories and feelings toward Trump," adding, "The relationship between the two leaders has always been excellent. The whole world knows this, and I do not consider it particularly surprising." (김 부장은 이날 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 ‘주요 국제 문제들에 대한 입장문’에서 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “아마도 우리 최고지도부의 대외정책과 관련해 내가 알지 못하고 있는 유일한 사안일 것”이라고 했다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장의 동생인 자신조차도 모르는 일이라는 것이다.)

She further asserted, "Regardless of the excellent relationship between the leaders of the two countries, the exercise of our sovereign rights to deter forces threatening our national security is entirely a matter of common sense." This is interpreted as reaffirming the legitimacy of North Korea's nuclear weapons possession. (다만 김 부장은 “우리 국가수반(김정은)이 트럼프에 대해 개인적으로 좋은 추억과 감정을 가지고 있다는데 대해서는 이미 여러 차례 밝힌 바 있다”며 “두 지도자들의 관계는 의연 훌륭하다. 이는 세상이 다 알고 있으며 별로 놀랄 만한 일은 아니라고 본다”고 했다.)

Earlier, the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported on the 18th, citing US officials, that President Trump has been pressuring his aides to explore options for a direct meeting with Chairman Kim as early as this fall. The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, scheduled to be held in November in Shenzhen, China, has been mentioned as a potential occasion. (이어 그는 “조미(북미) 두 나라 지도자들 사이의 훌륭한 관계와는 무관하게 우리가 자국의 안전을 위협하는 세력을 견제하기 위해 취하는 주권적 행사는 매우 상식적”이라고 주장했다. 이는 ‘핵 보유’의 정당성을 재차 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Regarding President Trump's directive to reduce US-South Korea joint military exercises, Kim referred to it as "the sudden announcement by the US president a few days ago to reduce US-ROK combined military drills." She stated, "We see no value in commenting on it and have no interest in it whatsoever," adding, "A reduction in the scale or duration of exercises does not change the inherently provocative and aggressive nature of such military drills." (앞서 월스트리트저널(WSJ)은 18일 미 당국자들을 인용해 트럼프 대통령이 참모들에게 이르면 올가을 김 위원장과 직접 만나는 방안을 검토하도록 압박하고 있다고 보도했다. 오는 11월 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의가 계기가 될 가능성이 거론된다.)

She also said, "If the US side intends to tout this measure as some kind of 'goodwill gesture,' they will not get the answer they want," and "We are not focused on the reduction or shortening of individual exercises, but rather on the reality that combined military exercises between the US and South Korea have been continuously conducted until now." (트럼프 대통령의 한미 연합 훈련 축소 지시와 관련해서 김 부장은 ‘며칠 전 미국 대통령이 돌연 발표한 미한 합동 군사 연습 축소’라고 언급했다. 그러면서 “우리는 그에 대하여 평할 가치가 없다고 보며 전혀 흥미를 느끼지 않는다”며 “훈련 규모나 기일이 줄어든다고 도발적·공격적인 군사 연습의 본질은 달라지지 않는다”고 밝혔다.)

Regarding recent claims by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky that North Korea has dispatched 50,000 troops to Russia, Kim denied the reports. "Claims of additional troop deployments by our military are completely groundless," she said, asserting that "the responsibility for the prolonged Ukraine crisis lies entirely with the United States and the West." <<>> (또 “미국 측이 이번에 취한 조치를 무슨 ‘선의의 조치’로 선전해보려고 타산한다면 원하는 답이 나오지 않을 것”이라​며 “우리는 개별적 훈련의 축소나 단축이 아니라 현재까지 미한 사이의 합동 군사 연습이 지속적으로 진행돼 왔다는 현실에 보다 주목하고 있다”라고도 했다.)

item.title: Calls Mount in Opposition for "Cho Hee-dae to Resign"... Unclear Whether Kim Min-seok Leadership Will Pursue Impeachment (與서 “조희대 사퇴” 목소리 쏟아져… 김민석 지도부, 탄핵 나설지 불투명)
item.description:
Calls Mount in Opposition for "Cho Hee-dae to Resign"... Unclear Whether Kim Min-seok Leadership Will Pursue Impeachment (與서 “조희대 사퇴” 목소리 쏟아져… 김민석 지도부, 탄핵 나설지 불투명)

Calls to pressure Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae over his position poured out from the Democratic Party of Korea on the 19th. The trigger was Chief Justice Cho's decision the previous day to break with the convention of coordinating with the presidential office and submit two Supreme Court justice nominees in writing, but within the party, some said, "This is the accumulated resentment exploding since the case of President Lee Jae-myung's Public Official Election Act violation was remanded with a guilty ruling just before last year's presidential election." However, because an impeachment of the Chief Justice by the Democratic Party has a low likelihood of being upheld by the Constitutional Court, which would place a heavy political burden on the ruling party as well, it remains unclear whether the Democratic Party leadership will formally pursue impeachment. (더불어민주당에서 19일 조희대 대법원장의 거취를 압박하는 목소리가 쏟아졌다. 전날 조 대법원장이 청와대와 조율하는 관례를 깨고 대법관 후보자 2명을 서면 제청한 것이 계기가 됐지만, 당 일각에선 “작년 대선 직전 이재명 대통령의 공직선거법 사건의 유죄 취지 파기환송 이후로 누적된 원한이 폭발한 것”이란 말이 나왔다. 다만 민주당에서 나오는 대법원장 탄핵은 헌법재판소에서 인용될 가능성이 낮아 여당으로서도 정치적 부담이 크기 때문에, 민주당 지도부가 공식적으로 탄핵 추진에 나설지 불투명하다.)

◇Conflict Accumulated Since the Remand of President Lee's Trial (◇李 대통령 재판 파기환송부터 쌓인 갈등)

At his first Supreme Council meeting since taking office, leader Kim Min-seok demanded Chief Justice Cho's resignation, saying, "Cho Hee-dae, step down immediately." Kim had mentioned the possibility of impeaching Chief Justice Cho during the party leadership election, citing judicial reform. However, on this day, while saying, "Under normal circumstances, he should have already been impeached," he did not bring up pursuing impeachment. A Democratic Party leadership official said, "We plan to coordinate specific measures through internal discussions." (김민석 대표는 이날 취임 후 첫 최고위원회의에서 조 대법원장을 향해 “조희대씨는 당장 나가시라”며 사퇴를 요구했다. 김 대표는 이번 당대표 선거 때 사법 개혁을 언급하며 조 대법원장 탄핵 가능성을 언급했었다. 다만 이날은 “원래대로라면 이미 탄핵됐어야 한다”고 하면서도 탄핵 추진 등은 꺼내지 않았다. 민주당 지도부 관계자는 “당내 논의를 통해 구체적 방침을 조율해 나갈 계획”이라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Park Ju-min also said on Facebook, addressing Chief Justice Cho, "Don't engage in politics while wearing the judicial robe," adding, "Remember that the more you do, the more justification for impeachment accumulates." Lawmaker Yeom Tae-young, a close associate of leader Kim Min-seok, said, "A remand just nine days before the presidential election, refusal to nominate Supreme Court justices for over six months, and a surprise nomination without consultation with the appointing authority," adding, "Chief Justice Cho, who disregards the constitutional order, is bringing impeachment upon himself." Lawmaker Park Ji-won said on a radio program, "Chief Justice Cho is ignoring both the National Assembly and the president and engaging in his own judicial politics," and warned, "If he continues this way, it will inevitably lead to his impeachment." (이날 박주민 의원도 페이스북에서 조 대법원장을 향해 “법복 입고 정치하지 마시라”며 “그럴수록 탄핵의 명분만 쌓여간다는 것을 명심하라”고 했다. 김민석 대표 측근인 염태영 의원도 “대선 직전 9일 만의 파기환송, 반년 넘게 대법관 제청 거부, 임명권자와 협의 없는 기습 제청”이라고 한 뒤 “헌정 질서를 무시하는 조 대법원장이 탄핵을 자초하고 있다”고 했다. 박지원 의원은 라디오에서 “조 대법원장이 국회도 무시하고 대통령도 무시하고 자기 사법 정치를 하고 있다”며 “이런 식으로 나가면 조 대법원장의 탄핵으로 이어질 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min also said regarding the passage of a motion in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day to summon Chief Justice Cho, "He has refused to appear citing trials and other reasons, but since the nomination of justices is judicial administration, he has no justification to refuse." (민주당 김용민 의원도 이날 법사위에서 조 대법원장의 출석 요구 안건이 가결된 데 대해 “그동안 재판 등을 이유로 출석을 거부해왔지만 임명 제청은 사법 행정이어서 거부할 명분이 없다”고 했다.)

The push to impeach Chief Justice Cho is not new within the Democratic Party. Immediately after the remand of President Lee's election law case in May of last year, the Democratic Party discussed impeaching Chief Justice Cho, calling it "judicial manipulation to block the Democratic Party's presidential election victory." However, the discussion was halted due to concerns about potential backlash from public opinion. In September of last year, after the Jung Cheong-rae leadership took office, the Democratic Party unilaterally held a "Cho Hee-dae hearing without Cho Hee-dae," which the opposition criticized as "a comedy-level hearing." Even in March of this year, under the Jung Cheong-rae leadership, some Democratic Party lawmakers signed an impeachment motion against Chief Justice Cho. But due to concerns about backlash affecting the June 3 local elections, it did not lead to an actual filing of the impeachment motion. (민주당 내 조 대법원장 탄핵론은 처음이 아니다. 민주당은 작년 5월 이 대통령 선거법 사건 파기환송 직후 “민주당의 대선 승리를 막기 위한 사법 농단”이라며 조 대법원장 탄핵을 논의했다. 하지만 여론의 역풍을 맞을 수 있다는 우려가 제기돼 논의를 중단하긴 했다. 정청래 지도부 출범 이후인 작년 9월엔 민주당 단독으로 ‘조희대 없는 조희대 청문회’를 열어, 야당이 “코미디 수준의 청문회”라고 비판했다. 민주당은 정청래 지도부였던 올 3월에도 일부 의원들이 조 대법원장 탄핵소추안에 서명했다. 하지만 6·3 지방선거에 미칠 역풍을 우려해 실제 탄핵안 발의로 이어지지는 않았다.)

◇Aiming to Effectively Shorten the Chief Justice's Term Through Suspension of Duties? (◇직무 정지로 대법원장 임기 단축 효과 노리나 )

The Democratic Party leadership is known to plan to first reiterate its demand for Chief Justice Cho to resign voluntarily. If he ultimately refuses, their position is that they could also pull out the "impeachment card." The key question is whether they will go as far as actually filing and voting on an impeachment motion. An impeachment motion against the Chief Justice can be proposed by at least one-third of all lawmakers and passed with the approval of a majority of all lawmakers. With 161 seats, the Democratic Party could pass it alone if it decides to make it party policy. If the impeachment motion passes, Chief Justice Cho's powers would be suspended until the Constitutional Court issues its impeachment ruling. (민주당 지도부는 우선 조 대법원장에게 자진 사퇴를 재차 요구할 것으로 알려졌다. 이를 끝내 수용하지 않으면 ‘탄핵 카드’도 꺼낼 수 있다는 입장이다. 관건은 실제 탄핵소추안 발의와 표결까지 나설지다. 대법원장 탄핵소추안은 재적 의원 3분의 1 이상이 발의하고 재적 의원 과반수가 찬성하면 의결된다. 민주당은 161석을 갖고 있어 당론으로 정하면 단독 의결도 가능하다. 탄핵소추안이 가결되면 조 대법원장은 헌법재판소의 탄핵심판 결정이 날 때까지 권한 행사가 정지된다.)

Chief Justice Cho, born June 6, 1957, can serve until June 5, 2027, under current law, which sets the retirement age for the Chief Justice at 70. If the Democratic Party pressures him to resign and Chief Justice Cho does not comply, the process could move to an impeachment motion, and if the Constitutional Court's review is prolonged, his duties could be suspended for a significant portion of his remaining term, regardless of the outcome of the ruling. (조 대법원장은 1957년 6월 6일생으로, 대법원장 정년이 70세인 현행법에 따라 2027년 6월 5일까지 재임할 수 있다. 민주당이 사퇴를 압박하다 조 대법원장이 응하지 않을 경우 탄핵소추로 넘어가고 헌재 심리가 장기화하면, 심판 결과와 별개로 남은 임기의 상당 기간 직무가 정지되는 결과가 생길 수 있다.)

However, if the Constitutional Court dismisses the impeachment, the political burden on the ruling party could grow. The Constitutional Court has ruled that dismissal requires not merely a violation of the law, but a serious violation of the Constitution or laws severe enough to warrant removal from public office. An impeachment decision also requires the approval of at least six justices. As for this written nomination, the Constitution only stipulates that Supreme Court justices are nominated by the Chief Justice and appointed by the president with the consent of the National Assembly; it does not specify prior consultation with the president or an in-person nomination. A ruling party official said, "If they push the impeachment motion and it gets dismissed, the ruling party, beyond just the newly launched Kim Min-seok leadership, could be in danger, along with opposition attacks about 'shaking the judiciary.'" (하지만 헌재가 탄핵을 기각할 경우 여당의 정치적 부담은 커질 수 있다. 헌재는 단순한 법 위반만으로 파면하는 것이 아니라, 공직에서 파면할 정도로 중대한 헌법·법률 위반이 있어야 한다고 판시해 왔다. 탄핵 결정에는 재판관 6명 이상의 찬성도 필요하다. 이번 서면 제청 역시 헌법은 대법관을 대법원장이 제청하고 국회 동의를 얻어 대통령이 임명하도록 규정할 뿐 대통령과의 사전 협의나 대면 제청을 명시하고 있지는 않다. 한 여권 관계자는 “탄핵안을 밀어붙였다가 기각되면 ‘사법부 흔들기’라는 야당 공세와 함께 이제 막 출범한 김민석 지도부를 넘어 여권 전체가 위험하다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea's Kim Yo-jong says she knows nothing of communication between North Korean and U.S. leaders (北 김여정 “북미 지도자간 소통, 전혀 알지 못해”)
item.description:
North Korea's Kim Yo-jong says she knows nothing of communication between North Korean and U.S. leaders (北 김여정 “북미 지도자간 소통, 전혀 알지 못해”)

Kim Yo-jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and deputy director of the Workers' Party Central Committee, said on the 19th that she knows nothing about U.S. President Donald Trump's claim that Kim Jong-un responded to a request for dialogue. (김정은 북한 국무위원장의 동생인 김여정 노동당 중앙위원회 부장은 19일 김정은이 대화 요청에 응답했다는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 주장에 대해 “전혀 알지 못하는 일”이라고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong issued a "statement on major international issues" through the Korean Central News Agency that evening. "Regarding news from Washington that there has been communication between the leaders of the DPRK and the United States recently, I know nothing about it," she said. "It is perhaps the only matter concerning our top leadership's foreign policy that I am unaware of." (김여정은 이날 밤 조선중앙통신을 통해 ‘주요 국제 문제들에 대한 입장’을 발표했다. 김여정은 “최근 조·미(북한·미국) 양국 지도자 사이에 소통이 있었다는 워싱턴발 소식에 대해 말한다면, 나는 전혀 알지 못하는 일”이라며 “아마도 우리 최고 지도부의 대외 정책과 관련해 내가 알지 못하고 있는 유일한 사안일 것”이라고 했다.)

When asked by reporters in the Oval Office on the 17th why Kim Jong-un had not responded to proposals for dialogue, President Trump countered, "How do you know he hasn't responded?" When a reporter followed up asking whether Trump meant Kim had responded, the president said, "Yes, he has." (트럼프 대통령은 지난 17일 백악관 집무실에서 취재진으로부터 ‘김정은이 그동안 왜 대화 제안에 반응이 없었느냐’는 질문을 받자 “그가 응답하지 않았다는 것을 어떻게 아느냐”고 반문했다. 취재진이 ‘김정은이 응답했다는 말이냐’고 되묻자 트럼프 대통령은 “그렇다. 응답했다”고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong said, "We have already stated on several occasions that our head of state holds personal fond memories and feelings toward Trump," but added, "The United States' hostile policy toward the DPRK has not changed, and the United States and its followers are fiercely conducting hostile military activities against the DPRK even at this very moment." (김여정은 “우리 국가수반(김정은)이 트럼프에 대해 개인적으로 좋은 추억과 감정을 갖고 있다는 데 대해서는 이미 여러 차례 밝힌 바 있다”면서도 “미국의 대조선 적대시 정책은 변하지 않아 왔고, 미국과 그 추종 무리는 이 순간에도 적대적인 대조선 군사 활동을 맹렬히 벌이고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the reduced ROK-U.S. joint exercises this year, which were scaled back at President Trump's request, she said, "We are not focused on the reduction or shortening of individual exercises, but on the reality that joint military drills have continued and are still ongoing." She indicated that they would attach no significance to the reduction, and that the drills must be completely halted. She also said of South Korea, "By talking about strengthening the solid ROK-U.S. alliance and accelerating the introduction of nuclear submarines, it has exposed its hostile identity without any filter." (트럼프 대통령의 요구로 축소된 올해 한미 연합 훈련에 대해선 “우리는 개별적 훈련의 축소나 단축이 아니라, 합동 군사 연습이 지속적으로 진행돼 오고 지금도 진행 중에 있다는 현실에 주목하고 있다”고 했다. 축소에 의미를 두지 않겠으며, 완전히 중단돼야 한다는 것이다. 그러면서 한국에 대해 “굳건한 한미 동맹 강화와 핵잠수함 도입의 가속화를 운운함으로써 자기의 적대적 정체성을 여과 없이 노출시켰다”고 했다.)

In response to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's claim that an additional 30,000 to 50,000 North Korean troops would be deployed to the Russia-Ukraine war, Kim Yo-jong also denied it, saying, "I take this opportunity to make clear that the claim of 'additional deployment' of our troops, devised and spread by the Zelensky clique, is a complete fabrication by Kyiv, and that responsibility for the outbreak and prolongation of the Ukraine crisis lies entirely with the United States and the West." (북한군 3만~5만명이 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁에 추가로 파병될 것이라는 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령의 주장에 대해서도 김여정은 “이 기회에, 젤렌스키 패당이 고안해 퍼뜨린 우리 군대의 ‘추가 파병’설은 전혀 사실무근한 키이우의 자작극이라는 것과 우크라이나 사태의 발단과 장기화의 책임은 전적으로 미국과 서방에 있다는 것을 명백히 한다”고 부인했다.)

item.title: Neither Cho nor Ahn Knew About the Reduction of Joint Exercises in Advance (조현도 안규백도 “연합훈련 축소, 사전에 몰랐다”)
item.description:
Neither Cho nor Ahn Knew About the Reduction of Joint Exercises in Advance (조현도 안규백도 “연합훈련 축소, 사전에 몰랐다”)

Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek stated on the 19th that they were unaware of the "policy to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises" until U.S. President Donald Trump ordered it via his social media platform, Truth Social, to the U.S. Department of War (Department of Defense). (조현 외교부 장관과 안규백 국방부 장관은 19일 ‘한미 연합훈련 축소 방침’을 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 자신의 소셜미디어인 트루스소셜을 통해 미 전쟁부(국방부)에 지시할 때까지 알지 못했다고 밝혔다.)

Minister Cho told the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee that day, "The content President Trump posted on Truth Social was not known in advance even by U.S. government officials," adding, "We were not notified in advance either." Minister Cho noted that since the reduction of exercises was discussed between South Korea and the U.S. after President Trump's directive on the 16th (local time), he does not consider it "a unilateral notification" from the U.S. side. (조 장관은 이날 국회 외통위에서 “트럼프 대통령이 트루스소셜에 밝힌 내용은 미 정부 관계자들도 전혀 사전에 알지 못했다”며 “저희도 사전에 통보받지 못했다”고 말했다. 조 장관은 지난 16일(현지 시각) 트럼프 대통령 지시 이후 한미 간 훈련 축소를 협의했기 때문에 “(미측의) 일방적 통보라고는 생각하지 않는다”고 했다.)

Regarding the background behind President Trump pulling out the card of reducing South Korea-U.S. joint exercises, which North Korea has opposed, even while pressuring ally South Korea, Minister Cho said, "Pressuring (South Korea's investment issues with the U.S.) is one of the motives." He added, "There is also a message toward North Korea, and with the Iran war in a stalemate, the intention to create a new breakthrough came out in a complex combination." On the impact that the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint exercises could have on the transition of wartime operational control, he said, "Since it is a reduction at the U.S.'s request, the transfer of wartime operational control should not be further delayed for this reason." (트럼프 대통령이 동맹인 한국을 압박하면서까지 북한이 반발해온 한미 연합훈련 축소 카드를 꺼내 든 배경에 대해, 조 장관은 “(한국의 대미 투자 문제를) 압박하는 것도 하나의 동기가 됐다고 본다”고 했다. 또 “대북 메시지도 있고, 이란전이 교착 상태에 빠지며 새로운 돌파구를 만들려는 의도가 복합적으로 나온 것”이라고 했다. 한미 연합훈련 축소가 전시작전통제권 전환에 미칠 영향에 대해선 “미측 요청에 따른 축소이므로 이를 이유로 전작권 이전을 더 늦추진 못할 것”이라고 했다.)

Minister Cho said, "We also summoned (U.S. Ambassador Michelle Steel) to Seoul for consultations," using the term "summoned," which carries a meaning of protest. However, Minister Cho said he does not believe President Trump's directive is "a matter to protest." (조 장관은 “서울에서도 (미셸 스틸) 주한 대사를 초치해 협의도 나눴다”며 항의의 의미를 담은 ‘초치’라는 표현을 사용했다. 다만 조 장관은 트럼프 대통령 지시가 “항의할 사안은 아니라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Minister Ahn also told the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day that regarding President Trump's directive, "No official from the South Korean or U.S. governments knew the contents." In light of Unification Minister Chung Dong-young's remarks about the "uranium enrichment facility," Minister Ahn said about the U.S. restrictions on sharing intelligence with North Korea, "There are partially quite significant restrictions." Although Minister Ahn had said in April that "there have been none (of such information restrictions) yet," this is the first time he has officially acknowledged them. (안 장관도 이날 국회 법사위에서 트럼프 대통령 지시는 “한미 정부 당국자는 아무도 내용을 몰랐다”고 했다. 안 장관은 정동영 통일부 장관의 ‘구성 우라늄 농축 시설’ 발언을 계기로 미측이 제한했던 대북 정보 공유에 대해 “부분적으로 상당히 제한 사항이 있다”고 했다. 안 장관은 지난 4월 “(일부 정보 제한이) 아직은 없었다”고 했지만, 이를 공식 인정한 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

During the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee meeting, the Democratic Party assessed the reduction of this year's regular South Korea-U.S. joint exercise, "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS), following President Trump's directive, as "a good opportunity to move inter-Korean relations forward." Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said, "I am sympathetic to President Trump's decision" and "I expect this to develop into meaningful North Korea-U.S. dialogue and expand to improvements in inter-Korean relations." In contrast, the People Power Party countered it as "a threat to national security." People Power Party lawmaker Kim Dae-sik, the opposition party's secretary on the committee, said, "We need to confirm whether this government is a partner in the South Korea-U.S. alliance or a party that unilaterally receives U.S. decisions." (외통위에서 더불어민주당은 트럼프 대통령 지시에 따라 올해 정례 한미 연합 연습 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)가 축소된 것에 대해 “남북 관계를 풀어가는 좋은 계기”라고 평가했다. 정동영 통일부 장관은 “트럼프 대통령의 결단에 대해서 공감하는 입장”이라며 “이것이 의미 있는 북미 대화로 전개되고, 남북 관계 개선으로까지 확장되기를 기대하고 있다”고 했다. 반면 국민의힘은 ‘국가 안보에 대한 위협’이라며 맞섰다. 외통위 야당 간사인 국민의힘 김대식 의원은 “이재명 정부가 한미 동맹의 파트너인지, 미국의 결정을 일방적으로 전달받는 당사자인지 확인해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Cho Hee-dae, Get Out Now" — Second Round of Pressure on the Chief Justice (김민석 “조희대씨 당장 나가라”… 대법원장 압박 2라운드)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "Cho Hee-dae, Get Out Now" — Second Round of Pressure on the Chief Justice (김민석 “조희대씨 당장 나가라”… 대법원장 압박 2라운드)

After Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae nominated two Supreme Court justice candidates on the 18th, the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea on the 19th argued that "breaking the convention of prior coordination with the presidential office and nominating justices via written submission is a declaration of intent to fight the president," calling for his resignation and pushing for impeachment proceedings. However, Noh Kyung-pil, head of the National Court Administration, appeared before the National Assembly that day and stated, "We requested a meeting with the presidential office (with President Lee Jae-myung), but there was no opportunity for a meeting," and added, "We discussed the written nomination with the senior presidential secretary for civil affairs." <<> Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok said at his first supreme council meeting since taking office that day, "Cho Hee-dae, the worst chief justice since liberation, should step down," and urged, "Come to your senses and get out right now." He further described Chief Justice Cho as a "delinquent student begging not to be expelled" and a "head of legal tricks," asking, "How dare you pull such vile acts in front of the people?" Supreme council member Choi Min-hee stated, "We must begin discussions on Chief Justice Cho's status, including impeachment," and some lawmakers also mentioned impeaching Chief Justice Cho. The Democratic Party also passed a motion that day at the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee to summon Chief Justice Cho to appear before parliament, despite opposition from the opposition party. <<> The Democratic Party has been attacking Chief Justice Cho consistently since the Supreme Court's en banc panel, just before last year's presidential election, remanded the election law case against then-candidate Lee Jae-myung, now president, with a guilty ruling. Earlier this year, during the leadership of Chung Chung-rae, some lawmakers pushed for the impeachment of Chief Justice Cho, but it was not adopted as party policy due to concerns over backlash. Impeaching the chief justice requires the motion to pass the National Assembly and then clear the Constitutional Court threshold, so even the ruling camp views its feasibility as low. On that day, leader Kim Min-seok also did not officially mention pursuing impeachment, only demanding resignation. The People Power Party responded, "If they impeach the chief justice, the people will surely impeach this administration." (조희대 대법원장이 지난 18일 대법관 후보자 2명을 임명 제청한 가운데, 더불어민주당 지도부에서 19일 “청와대와 사전 조율하는 관례를 깨고 대법관을 서면 제청한 것은 대통령과 싸워 보겠다는 것”이라며 사퇴 요구 및 탄핵 추진 주장이 나왔다. 그러나 노경필 대법원 법원행정처장은 이날 국회에 출석해 “청와대에 (이재명 대통령과의 면담을) 요구했는데 만남의 기회가 없었다”, “민정수석과 서면 제청하는 걸 협의했다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Kim Yong-gwan Featured in Aug. 15 Celebration Video… Why Are His Descendants Enraged? ([단독] 8·15 경축식 영상에 나온 김용관 선생… 후손들은 왜 분노했나)
item.description:
Of the six independence activists featured in the video shown at the Aug. 15 Liberation Day ceremony, Kim Yong-gwan (1897–1967) has been confirmed not to be a "person of merit for independence" because he never received a state decoration. President Lee Jae-myung and his wife also attended the event that day. Kim Yong-gwan's bereaved family told this newspaper on the 19th: "It infuriates us that the government, which says it will expand the discovery of unhonored independence activists, refuses to recognize him as a person of merit for independence, yet politically exploits him in the Liberation Day video." <<> The ceremony video shown on the 15th at Seoul Sejong Center for the Performing Arts featured six figures: Kim Gu, Ahn Chang-ho, Lee Hoe-young, Jeong Se-kwon, Jo So-ang, and Kim Yong-gwan. Kim Yong-gwan was introduced as an activist who led industrialization under the theme "Building National Strength Through Science." However, a government official said: "In the process of producing the theme video, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety did not consult with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, and as a result, they were apparently unaware that Kim Yong-gwan had not been selected as a person of merit for independence." <<> According to this newspaper's comprehensive reporting, the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs had rejected Kim Yong-gwan's application for recognition as a person of merit for independence three times, citing "unclear independence movement activities." When President Moon Jae-in named five "independence activists" in his Aug. 15 Liberation Day address, Kim was the only one among them who was not a recognized person of merit. At the time, public opinion called for designating Kim as a person of merit, but he ultimately never received that recognition. <<> Choi Seong-hyeon (56), the grandson-in-law of Kim Yong-gwan, told this newspaper: "There are reports that he was arrested by the Japanese police in April 1938 after giving a lecture at the Jongno YMCA hall in Seoul on the 5th Science Day, but the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs says there is no specific detention record and refuses to recognize him as a person of merit." He added, "Presenting Kim as an independence activist at an official government event is insulting and mocking his descendants." The bereaved family reportedly gave up years ago on having him recognized as a "person of merit for independence" and destroyed all related supporting documents. <<> Kim Yong-gwan studied in Japan and was a leading figure in popularizing science and technology. Believing that a scientific revival was necessary to strengthen national power, he organized the "Invention Society" in 1924 and founded "Science Joseon," Korea's first popular science magazine, in 1933. In 1934, he established "Science Day" and devoted himself to enlightenment campaigns promoting the importance of science. The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs is known to view these activities as not being directly linked to the independence movement. The government designated Kim as a Korea Science and Technology Merit Honoree in 2020, but unlike national merit honorees, science and technology merit honorees reportedly receive no support or special treatment for their descendants. <<> Kim Geun-bae, a professor emeritus at Jeonbuk National University and current visiting professor at KAIST who specializes in modern Korean science history, said: "Even if it's hard to see a direct link to the independence movement, scientists who carried out scientific activities during the Japanese colonial period for the Korean people should be considered by the government as veterans deserving of honors equivalent to persons of merit for independence." He added, "The 'construction of a scientific Joseon' that Kim Yong-gwan and his colleagues championed at the time became linked to the 'nation-building through science' policy, which gave rise to today's Republic of Korea." (8·15 광복절 경축식 주제 영상에 등장했던 독립운동가 6명 중 김용관(1897~1967) 선생이 정부 서훈을 받지 못해 ‘독립유공자’가 아닌 것으로 확인됐다. 이날 행사엔 이재명 대통령 부부도 참석했다. 김용관 선생의 유가족은 19일 본지에 “미서훈 독립운동가 발굴을 확대하겠다는 정부가 독립유공자로 인정은 안 해주면서, 광복절 영상에서 정치적으로 이용하는 것에 분통이 터진다”고 했다.)

item.title: Trump, shaking up the security triad, seeks to meet Kim Jong-un (김정은 만나려, 안보 3축 흔드는 트럼프)
item.description:
Trump, shaking up the security triad, seeks to meet Kim Jong-un (김정은 만나려, 안보 3축 흔드는 트럼프)

The specter of a U.S.-North Korea summit is once again haunting Northeast Asia. Facing daunting challenges at home and abroad, including the Iran issue, U.S. President Donald Trump has revived this specter in search of a diplomatic breakthrough, and it is expected to roil the Korean Peninsula situation throughout the second half of this year, bringing considerable repercussions. Compared to the APEC (Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation) summit in Gyeongju last October, this summit speculation is characterized by Trump taking a lower posture, playing even more favorably into Kim Jong-un's hands, and being disadvantageous to South Korea's security. <<> The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported on the 18th, citing U.S. officials, that Trump is pressing his aides to explore ways to arrange a meeting with Kim Jong-un as early as this fall. The APEC summit scheduled for November in Shenzhen, China, and Trump's Asia tour are being floated as potential opportunities. The U.S. State Department maintains its position of being open to "dialogue without preconditions" with North Korea. <<> The South Korean government is also emphasizing the resumption of dialogue with North Korea and the easing of tensions. President Lee Jae-myung has described Trump as a "peacemaker" and himself as a "pacemaker," expressing his commitment to supporting U.S.-North Korea dialogue. If these currents converge, this fall on the Korean Peninsula could see a situation where the disparate interests of the two Koreas and the United States meet at a curiously single point. <<> Should Trump and Kim Jong-un meet again, it would be their fourth face-to-face encounter, following Singapore in 2018 and Hanoi and Panmunjom in 2019. However, the situation now is vastly different from 2019, when the two met twice. At that time, Kim Jong-un traveled all the way to Vietnam on his private train, investing considerable effort in the Hanoi summit, only to return empty-handed with a "no-deal" outcome. It was a painful diplomatic failure for Kim. For this reason, it is highly likely he will not return to the negotiating table unless conditions are clearly different from those in Hanoi. <<> ◇Trump desperate ahead of midterms... handing Kim Jong-un a "nuclear ace card"? <<> Over the past seven years, North Korea's "status" has changed beyond recognition. The North has significantly advanced its nuclear and missile capabilities. There are even estimates that North Korea already possesses around 100 nuclear weapons. Following Russian President Vladimir Putin's visit to Pyongyang in 2024, North Korea-Russia relations have evolved into a de facto military alliance, and the deployment of North Korean troops to Russia has become a reality. Chinese President Xi Jinping also made a state visit to North Korea last June, the first in seven years, reflecting the improved ties. China and Russia have been acting as steadfast patrons for North Korea by neutralizing the sanctions regime they once agreed to at the U.N. Security Council. <<> Against this backdrop, if Kim Jong-un meets Trump again, he is highly likely to make recognition of North Korea as a "nuclear weapons state" the starting point of negotiations, rather than "what will we do for denuclearization." In effect, the conditions have been set for him to raise the stakes far higher than at the Hanoi summit in 2019. <<> Trump, on the other hand, desperately needs a diplomatic achievement. With midterm elections looming, he needs a political breakthrough, so attention is focused on how far he will concede on existing North Korea policy principles to make a summit happen. Having already drastically reduced ROK-U.S. joint military exercises, it cannot be ruled out that he might use issues directly tied to South Korea's security—such as recognizing North Korea's nuclear status or withdrawing or drastically reducing U.S. troops in South Korea—as negotiating cards. <<> Scenarios for a U.S.-North Korea summit <<> It is difficult to predict whether a U.S.-North Korea summit will materialize. However, from Kim Jong-un's perspective, he cannot ignore the consequences of continuing to spurn repeated summit overtures from the president of the world's most powerful nation. In this regard, the likelihood of a summit seems higher than last year. <<> The first scenario mentioned by the WSJ is a meeting around the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, in November. A U.S.-North Korea summit could be pursued in conjunction with Trump's itinerary in China. <<> Given that Trump needs a diplomatic achievement ahead of the November 3 midterm elections, he might consider a surprise meeting in September or October. If he judges that a political reversal is needed before the election, the timing of the summit could be moved up in the form of a so-called "October Surprise." <<> North Korea is not an APEC member, and Kim Jong-un has no precedent of attending multilateral summit meetings. Given that the likelihood of Kim appearing on the APEC stage is low, the possibility of a meeting in Shenzhen, China, appears slim. <<> For this reason, possible venues include a separate location in China or a third country, alongside the unconventional scenario of Trump visiting Pyongyang. Given his political style, a Trump visit to Pyongyang cannot be entirely ruled out as a card. The image of a sitting U.S. president landing at Pyongyang's Sunan Airport and being received by Kim Jong-un would capture global attention. For Trump, it would be an event that maximizes his "deal-maker" image while delivering to American voters the message that only he can solve the North Korea problem. <<> U.S.-North Korea summit and the wartime operational control (OPCON) variable <<> The U.S.-North Korea summit draws attention because it intersects with the Lee Jae-myung administration's strong push for the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON). Trump has long downplayed the value of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK), voicing strong dissatisfaction over stationing costs and South Korea's burden-sharing for defense. He has consistently framed USFK not as a core asset supporting U.S. strategy in Northeast Asia, but as a cost borne by the United States for South Korea's defense, while indicating his willingness to transfer OPCON. <<> The Lee Jae-myung administration emphasizes OPCON transition as a matter of sovereignty, advocating its "restoration." It is also proactive in transforming the armistice regime into a peace regime. Although the Trump and Lee administrations have completely different ideologies and policies, they could ultimately converge on the aspects of "expanding the role of South Korean forces and reducing the direct U.S. military burden." <<> If Kim Jong-un's demands are added to the mix, the situation could advance even more rapidly. In negotiations with the United States, Kim is likely to demand the permanent suspension of ROK-U.S. joint exercises, the cessation of the deployment of U.S. strategic assets to the Korean Peninsula, and changes to the size and role of USFK, if the withdrawal of U.S. troops is not accepted. <<> If Trump accepts this as a "deal for peace on the Korean Peninsula" and the South Korean government pushes OPCON transition as a matter of "restoring military sovereignty," the divergent interests of the three leaders—Trump, Lee, and Kim—could align. Within the grand political event of a U.S.-North Korea summit, recognition of North Korea's nuclear status, the withdrawal or drastic reduction of U.S. troops in South Korea, and OPCON transition could all become intertwined at once, potentially shaking the very foundation of South Korea's security structure. <<> A U.S.-North Korea summit pursued by Trump while disregarding all existing North Korea policy principles may outwardly appear to improve relations among the two Koreas and the United States and foster a peaceful atmosphere on the Peninsula, but concerns are growing that it could paradoxically weaken South Korea's deterrence. (미·북 정상회담이라는 유령이 다시 동북아시아를 떠돌기 시작했다. 이란 문제 등 국내외 난제에 직면한 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 외교적 돌파구를 찾기 위해 다시 띄운 이 유령은 올 하반기 내내 한반도 정세를 뒤흔들며 적지 않은 파장을 몰고 올 전망이다. 이번 회담설은 지난해 10월 경주 APEC(아시아·태평양경제협력체) 정상회의 때에 비해 트럼프가 저자세이고, 북한의 김정은에게는 더할 나위 없이 유리하며 대한민국의 안보에는 불리하다는 것이 특징이다.)
