item.title: Lee Says "Party, Government, and Presidential Office Are a Community of Fate" — Dinner with Three Leadership Candidates (李 “당정청은 운명 공동체”… 당권 경쟁 3인과 만찬)
item.description:
Lee Says "Party, Government, and Presidential Office Are a Community of Fate" — Dinner with Three Leadership Candidates (李 “당정청은 운명 공동체”… 당권 경쟁 3인과 만찬)

President Lee Jae-myung hosted a dinner at the presidential residence on the 19th, inviting Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok, former leader candidate Chung Cheong-rae, and lawmaker Song Young-gil. The move is seen as an attempt to mend the deep internal divisions that peaked during the party convention amid pro-Lee and pro-Chung tensions and to pursue unity. (이재명 대통령이 19일 더불어민주당 김민석 대표와 당대표 후보였던 정청래 전 대표, 송영길 의원을 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 했다. 이번 전당대회에서 친명·친청 간 갈등으로 극에 달한 내분을 봉합하고 통합을 도모하려는 시도로 풀이된다.)

The dinner was proposed by President Lee and took place just two days after the Democratic Party's national convention concluded. From the presidential office, Chief of Staff Kang Hun-sik and Senior Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo attended, while the Democratic Party was represented by floor leader Han Byeong-do. Those gathered at the presidential residence at 6:30 p.m. reportedly shared conversation over drinks for more than four hours. Senior Secretary Hong said in a written briefing, "It was a gathering to celebrate the party's new beginning and share a spirit of harmony," adding, "It proceeded in a congenial atmosphere." (이날 만찬은 이 대통령의 제안으로, 민주당 전당대회가 끝난 지 이틀 만에 성사됐다. 청와대에선 강훈식 대통령비서실장과 홍익표 정무수석이 배석했고, 민주당에선 한병도 원내대표가 배석했다. 저녁 6시30분에 청와대에서 만난 참석자들은 4시간 넘게 반주를 곁들이며 이야기를 나눴다고 한다. 홍 수석은 서면 브리핑을 통해 “당의 새로운 출발을 축하하고, 화합의 뜻을 나누기 위한 자리”라며 “화기애애한 분위기 속에서 진행됐다”고 했다.)

The attendees posed for a commemorative photo on the steps of the main building of the presidential residence around 6:30 p.m., holding hands and smiling alongside President Lee. Party leader Kim Min-seok and former leader Chung Cheong-rae stood on either side of the president, clasping hands. They then moved to the dining hall, where they sat around a round table and toasted with fresh fruit juice. The dinner featured ginseng yukhoe with yuzu sauce, sweet pumpkin tarakjuk, cod fritters, beef fritters, tofu fritters, grilled hanwoo sirloin, and freshwater snail soybean paste stew. Regarding the ginseng yukhoe, the presidential office explained, "It's a menu using signature ingredients from the hometowns of the party leader candidates, named 'unity yukhoe,'" adding, "It reflects the president's wish that the candidates, who worked hard traveling across the country, would relieve their fatigue and recover their health." (참석자들은 이날 오후 6시30분쯤 청와대 본관 계단에서 이 대통령과 함께 손을 맞잡고 웃으며 기념 촬영을 했다. 이 대통령 양옆으로는 김민석 대표와 정 전 대표가 자리해 손을 잡았다. 이들은 만찬장으로 이동해 원형 테이블에 둘러앉아 생과일 주스로 건배했다. 만찬으로는 유자 소스를 곁들인 인삼 육회와 단호박 타락죽, 대구전·육전·두부전, 한우 살치살 구이, 다슬기 된장국 등이 준비됐다. 인삼 육회에 대해 청와대는 “당대표 후보자들의 고향 대표 식재료를 활용한 메뉴로 ‘단합 육회’라 이름을 붙였다”며 “전국 곳곳을 돌며 고생한 후보자들이 피로를 풀고 건강을 회복했으면 하는 대통령의 마음이 담겼다”고 전했다.)

At the gathering, President Lee conveyed congratulations to leader Kim and urged cooperation among the party, government, and presidential office. He also offered words of encouragement to former leader Chung and lawmaker Song, who had competed against Kim, saying, "All three party leader candidates are comrades who have shared joys and sorrows together and responsible pillars of the people-sovereignty government." Earlier, in a video address at the Democratic Party convention, President Lee had also emphasized party unity, stating, "The Democratic Party was strongest when it was one." (이 대통령은 이 자리에서 김 대표에게 축하 메시지를 전하고, 당·정·청 간 협력을 당부했다. 김 대표와 경쟁했던 정 전 대표와 송 의원을 향해서도 격려의 뜻을 전하며 “당대표 후보 세 사람 모두 생사고락을 함께한 동지이자 국민주권정부의 책임 있는 주역”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 앞서 민주당 전당대회 영상 축사에서도 “민주당은 하나일 때 가장 강했다”며 당의 단합을 강조한 바 있다.)

The candidates who had traded barbs during the convention also issued reconciliatory messages. According to the presidential office, leader Kim apologized to former leader Chung for some excessive remarks made during the convention process and said, "Let's work together for party unity and to support the administration." Lawmaker Song also stated, "I resolved misunderstandings with comrade Chung Cheong-rae and expressed regret over the controversies during the convention." Former leader Chung said, "We are comrades and fellow soldiers who crossed the line of death together during the December 3 martial law insurrection, and as a community of fate with the Lee Jae-myung government, we must join forces to achieve a new mandate through certain victory in the by-elections and presidential election." A presidential office official said, "With drinks flowing, it likely became a time for candid conversation and clearing up misunderstandings." (전당대회 기간 공격을 주고받았던 후보들도 화해 메시지를 내놨다. 청와대에 따르면 김 대표는 정 전 대표에게 전당대회 과정에서의 일부 과한 표현에 대해 사과했고, “당의 단합과 국정 운영의 뒷받침을 함께하자”고 했다. 송 의원도 “정청래 동지와 오해를 풀고 전당대회 과정에서의 논란에 대해 유감을 표명했다”고 했다. 정 전 대표는 “우리는 12·3 비상계엄 내란의 사선을 함께 넘은 동지이자 전우이고, 이재명 정부와 운명 공동체로 반드시 총선, 대선 승리로 정권 재창출에 힘을 모아야 한다”고 했다. 청와대 관계자는 “반주를 곁들이면서 서로가 허심탄회한 대화를 나누고 오해를 푼 시간이 됐을 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee urged, "The party, government, and presidential office are a community of fate bearing the era's calling together and partners in state affairs," adding, "Please join forces." Senior Secretary Hong conveyed that the attendees agreed to strive as a "stronger one team" for the success of the people-sovereignty government. (이 대통령은 “당·정·청은 시대적 소명을 함께 짊어진 운명 공동체이자 국정 동반자”라며 “함께 힘을 모아줄 것”이라고 당부했다. 참석자들은 ‘더 강한 원팀’으로 국민주권정부의 성공을 위해 최선을 다하자는 데 뜻을 모았다고 홍 수석은 전했다.)

It was reported that some pending national issues were also discussed at the gathering. Lawmaker Song expressed the view that coordination between the party and the presidential office was needed regarding real estate taxation. Major issues requiring close coordination between the party and government—including the three mega projects, real estate policies, and next year's budget—were expected to be discussed, though specific details were not disclosed. (이 자리에선 일부 국정 현안에 대한 이야기도 오간 것으로 전해졌다. 송 의원은 부동산 세제와 관련해 당·청 간 조정이 필요하다는 의견을 전했다. 3대 메가 프로젝트를 비롯해 부동산 정책과 내년 예산안 등 당정 간 긴밀한 조율이 필요한 주요 현안이 논의될 것으로 전망됐으나, 구체적 내용에 대해선 알려지지 않았다.)

item.title: Trump: "South Korea Not Interested in Helping on Hormuz... I Wasn't Happy" (트럼프 “한국, 호르무즈 문제 돕는데 관심 없어… 기분 별로였다”)
item.description:
President Donald Trump said on the 19th that he "was not happy" when South Korea said it was not interested in helping the United States in the Strait of Hormuz, revealing that President Lee Jae-myung declined his request for assistance. Just two days after expressing his displeasure by even disclosing his phone call with President Lee on the 17th, Trump again brought it up, saying "he said 'no, thank you.'" Trump also addressed his directive to drastically reduce South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, saying, "I have a friendship with Kim Jong-un, and he's been behaving well at least during my term, so I thought (conducting exercises) would be extremely insulting." (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 19일 “한국이 호르무즈 해협에서 우리를 돕는 데 관심이 없다고 말했을 때 기분이 별로였다(not happy)”며 이재명 대통령이 자신의 도움 요청을 사양했다고 밝혔다. 지난 17일 이 대통령과의 전화 통화 사실까지 공개해 가며 불만을 표출한 지 이틀 만에 “그가 ‘노 땡큐(no, thank you)’라고 말했다”며 이를 재차 거론한 것이다. 트럼프는 한미 연합 훈련 대폭 축소 지시 관련 “김정은과 친분이 있고 적어도 내 임기 동안 잘 행동하고 있는데 (훈련을 하는 것이) 굉장히 모욕적(insulting)일 것으로 생각했다”고도 했다.)

Trump made these remarks while meeting with reporters at the White House that afternoon, claiming that "South Korea imports 60% of its crude oil from the Strait of Hormuz." On his relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong-un, he said, "He didn't like Biden or Obama, but I maintain a good relationship" and added, "Even though I have a friendly relationship with him, I didn't like that we were conducting large-scale military exercises against North Korea, because I thought nothing would have happened." Earlier that morning, Trump claimed that North Korea possesses 57 powerful nuclear weapons and said he would meet with Kim Jong-un within the year. <<> When asked whether his goal in resuming relations with Kim Jong-un remains denuclearization and whether he expects to succeed this time, Trump avoided a specific answer, saying, "I don't want to talk about that." During his first term, Trump met with Kim Jong-un three times—in Singapore, Hanoi, Vietnam, and at Panmunjom—but achieved little. Unlike his first term, North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities have advanced, and its strategic cooperation with Russia has deepened, so it remains uncertain whether Kim Jong-un will readily accept an offer for dialogue. North Korea maintains that it can only respond to talks if the United States recognizes its status as a "nuclear-armed state," while the Trump administration has upheld its official position of "pursuing the complete denuclearization of North Korea," regardless of the president referring to Kim Jong-un as a "nuclear power." <<> Meanwhile, President Lee said on his X (formerly Twitter) account on the 19th, "The South Korean government has stated on multiple occasions that it will actively join international efforts to restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," adding, "We will continue to communicate closely with the U.S. side, as we have done so far, on various concrete contribution measures within the scope that South Korea's laws and basic policies can accommodate." He continued, "I look forward to reuniting with the esteemed President Trump in the United States in the near future," referring to the G20 summit scheduled for December at Trump's Doral resort in Florida. (트럼프는 이날 오후 백악관에서 기자들과 만나 ‘한국이 원유 수입의 60%를 호르무즈 해협에서 들여오고 있다’고 주장하며 이같이 밝혔다. 그는 북한 김정은과의 관계에 대해 “그는 바이든도, 오바마도 좋아하지 않았지만 나는 좋은 관계를 유지하고 있다”며 “그와 우호적인 관계를 맺고 있는데도 우리가 북한을 상대로 한 대규모 군사 훈련을 벌이고 있다는 사실이 마음에 들지 않았다. 아무 일도 일어나지 않았을 것 같기 때문”이라고 했다. 트럼프는 이날 오전에는 북한이 강력한 핵무기 57개를 보유하고 있다며 연내에 김정은과 만날 것이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon and Yoo Ui-dong's 'Yongsan Defense Line'... Ruling Party Says "The Ministry of Land Can Just Push It Through" (오세훈·유의동 ‘용산 방어선’… 與 “국토부가 그냥 밀고 갈수 있다”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon and Yoo Ui-dong's 'Yongsan Defense Line'... Ruling Party Says "The Ministry of Land Can Just Push It Through" (오세훈·유의동 ‘용산 방어선’… 與 “국토부가 그냥 밀고 갈수 있다”)

Tensions between the ruling and opposition parties are escalating over the government's announcement to build a large-scale youth rental housing complex in Seoul's Yongsan Park. The presidential office stated on the 19th, "It's very important that this prime piece of land is put to good use," expressing its commitment to creating the housing complex. Although the Seoul Metropolitan Government and Yongsan District Office are opposed, some in the Democratic Party of Korea have said, "If the Special Act on the Creation of Yongsan Park is amended, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport can just push it through." A Seoul city government official said, "As backlash against the real estate policy grows, they are casually targeting even a national park as a site for housing supply and using young people to drown out opposing voices," adding, "Given the various side effects and the actual supply effect, this can only be described as a headstrong approach." <<> Ha Jun-kyung, the presidential office's senior secretary for economic growth, appeared on TV Chosun that day and said, "Yongsan Park is enormous—larger than Yeouido," announcing the plan to use part of Yongsan Park as a site for youth housing. Senior Secretary Ha said, "Large parks also cause many public safety issues and generate social costs, so we need to discuss how to make the best use of this land." He added, "If you visit the Yongsan Children's Garden area now, there aren't many people," and "We want our young people to be able to get married and have children there (through youth housing)." <<> Senior Secretary Ha had appeared on CBS Radio on the 13th and said, "We need to have a social discussion about whether it's good to keep (Yongsan Park) vacant." That day, he again said the matter would go through public deliberation, but he acknowledged reports that youth rental housing supply and other measures were being pursued. <<> Amid this, lawmakers from the Democratic Party on the National Assembly's Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee and Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok held a ruling party-government consultation meeting at the National Assembly that day to discuss the development plan for Yongsan Park. The Democratic Party is considering passing an amendment to the Special Act on the Creation of Yongsan Park at the National Assembly's plenary session on the 20th. Since the Special Act enacted in 2007 designated Yongsan Park as a national park, building housing there would require amending the law. Rep. Kim Young-bae (Seongbuk-gu, Seoul), who chairs the Democratic Party's Seoul city chapter, said in an MBC Radio interview that day, "If (the amendment) passes, city and provincial governors or district heads have no authority at all—the city of Seoul is a party to cooperate with, not the subject of approval," adding, "If the Ministry of Land decides to move forward, it can just push it through." <<> However, the amendment currently on the plenary agenda only expands the scope of use for sites like 'Camp Kim' near Yongsan Park, which were already announced as housing supply locations. To develop the Yongsan Children's Garden area, which the government is considering as a youth housing site, a separate legislative amendment would be required. Even if the law is changed to allow the project to proceed, matters such as construction, landscape, and traffic fall under the jurisdiction of the city or district offices, making it difficult for the project to gain momentum without local government cooperation. <<> The obstacles don't end there. Because the Yongsan Park site was used as a military base by the Japanese imperial army and U.S. Forces Korea for over a century, it could take several years before housing construction can even begin, factoring in the time needed for soil remediation. Above all, there is deep concern that the project is being pursued as a unilateral government plan without proper discussion of the reduction of green space and the erosion of urban value. Rep. Kwon Young-se (Yongsan, Seoul) of the People Power Party said, "The way the Lee Jae-myung administration handles affairs is unilateral—once the president decides, the opinions of citizens and stakeholders are ignored," adding, "This must be scrapped entirely." <<> Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon attended a National Assembly forum that day and said, "The government is trying to cover up its failure to control housing prices by throwing Yongsan Park into the mix." Mayor Oh and Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party lawmaker who chairs the Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee, met at Seoul City Hall that day and reaffirmed their opposition to developing Yongsan Park. Within the Democratic Party, there is talk that if Chairman Yoo blocks the bill's passage, they could bypass him and force it through. Under the National Assembly Act, if a committee chair refuses or avoids convening meetings or proceeding with agenda items, the senior secretary of the majority party can act as chair and conduct the proceedings. <<> A Democratic Party official said, "Mayor Oh and the People Power Party are blocking the Yongsan Park development because they calculate that the more delayed and unsuccessful the housing supply measures are, the more political gain they'll reap," adding, "This kind of obstruction of the government must be cut off." In contrast, a People Power Party official said, "The government and ruling party are pretending to supply housing to recover the president's plunging approval ratings and support among the 2030 generation, and trying to frame the opposition as blocking youth housing—that's the political calculation." (정부가 서울 용산공원에 대규모 청년 임대주택 단지를 조성하겠다고 한 것을 두고 여야 갈등이 고조되고 있다. 청와대는 19일 “이 금싸라기 땅이 잘 이용되는 게 되게 중요하다”며 주택 단지 조성 의지를 밝혔다. 서울시·용산구 등이 반대하고 있지만 더불어민주당에선 “용산공원조성특별법만 개정하면 국토부가 그냥 밀고 나갈 수 있다”는 말도 나왔다. 서울시 관계자는 “부동산 정책에 대한 반발이 커지자 아무렇지 않게 국가공원까지 주택 공급 대상으로 삼고, 청년을 앞세워 반대 목소리를 무마하려는 것”이라며 “각종 부작용과 실제 공급 효과를 감안하면 막무가내식 접근이라고 할 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)
